description: ApexLog is a track day logbook for drivers. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask about your own driving history in plain language: compare two laps sector by sector, see where you lost time, pull the setup and tyre state you ran at an event, check how many laps are on a set of pads or tyres, or read the GPS trace of your best lap — including OBD channels such as fuel and temperatures when they were logged. It holds the full context around your laps — vehicle, tyre model and age, per-session setup, component wear, weather and track — so the assistant answers with your real data. The connector is read-only and scoped to your own account; it never changes or deletes anything. You bring your own ChatGPT plan, so there are no question limits.
